sections.title: Workbook visibility test
sections.what: Builds three sample facts (admitted, held out, and never reviewed) and checks the summary counts, that the owner field is marked partially supported with all three reports still shown, and that missing fields are listed correctly.
sections.why: Stated in the assertion message: rejected candidates must stay visible.
sections.watch_out: Only the owner field is checked, so the other tabs have no coverage here.

summary: Tests that the research workbook keeps rejected candidate facts visible and correctly counts admitted, not admitted and missing fields.
purpose: Protects the workbook's honesty: refused claims must stay visible, not disappear.
why: Stated in an assertion message: rejected candidates must remain visible, not disappear.
how: Builds three sample facts: one admitted, one held out, and one never reviewed. Also builds a sample project record and project list. Runs the workbook builder and checks the summary counts, the owner field's status and report count, and that the missing list is right.
inputs: Fixed sample text, sample facts and a sample record.
outputs: Pass or fail results from the test runner.
risks: Only the owner field is checked, so other tabs have no test here. The sample is cast to a type.
debug: If it fails, read the failing assertion. Compare the workbook builder's status rules and the admission rules in semanticPolicy.
